liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Good Morning Little Schoolgirl** (2 reviews): Excellent Schoolgirl continues Pigpen's raunchy stretch, while Doin' That Rag is judged below average and interrupts it; Schoolgirl has a big harmonica part, with the harp competing with Jerry's guitar for solo space [3][11]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Reviewer rates Jerry's Dew among the best of the period; Dew is not a slow-building majestic climax but a wailing, southern-rock-tinged flurry of Jerry guitar runs, like the Lovelight solos [3][6]
- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Unhurried Dark Star where the band listens closely, following the contours of the classic Live/Dead version; Reviewer describes Dark Star opening with about a 20-minute Jerry solo introduction [4][11]
- **Drums** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer hears no Caution; sees Drums into a jam, possibly the usual closing jam, before the tape cuts off; The tape's end is missing; the jam out of Drums suggests Caution followed [2][9]
- **St. Stephen** (1 review): Reviewer especially loves the St. Stephen into The Eleven pairing [10]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Eleven huge and essential listening, and says reviews overlook it [8]
- **Death Don't Have No Mercy** (1 review): Reviewer finds Death Don't Have No Mercy beautiful and poetic [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-04-13.sbd.miller.87378.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 11 songs; 119 min; rated 3.91/5 by 23 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound is good but not perfect: a slight hiss and a few defects [11]
- **gd69-04-13.sbd.cotsman.6287.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 120 min; rated 3.64/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: The end of Lovelight is cut off in this soundboard, which loses the point where Pigpen had the crowd in hand; The recording is incomplete, ending with a cut after the post-Drums jam; Several minutes are missing at the end of Lovelight and the start of Doin' That Rag [2][3][9]

## Around the show

- Reviewer found it while searching for Dark Stars; Dark Star and Lovelight each run over twenty minutes [12]
- Reviewer considers the Dark Star > St. Stephen > Eleven sequence among the finest heard in a long time [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-04-13.sbd.miller.87378.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [1]
- **gd69-04-13.sbd.cotsman.6287.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Dan Zymanski and J. Cotsman; source: Soundboard [2]
